mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% signals an emergency monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate policy support during economic stress.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs as consumer spending expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month with t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% over three months indicate collapsing consumer and housing demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recessionary expectations intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline > 5% in 3 months with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95% of its 2017 base year value signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 with t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annualized signals persistent inflation that forces premature monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls falling below 135 million signals severe job market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000.0 with t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as central bank policy effectiveness diminishes.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (>2%) and unemployment rate increase (>0.3pp) over one month signals recession onset, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic contraction accelerates.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 2% in 1 month and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 2% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month with t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline.
